title: Military And Attacks By Mongols And Other Turks
definition: The persistent threat of Mongol invasions from Central Asia and the internal pressure from rival Turkic factions necessitated the transformation of the Delhi Sultanate into a militarized state. This period defined the evolution of frontier defense, administrative centralization, and military logistics in medieval India.
importanceInUpsc: This topic is critical for understanding the 'Garrison State' model of the Sultanate, the evolution of the Iqta system, and the geopolitical shifts that influenced the rise and fall of dynasties from Iltutmish to the Tughlaqs.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Military And Attacks By Mongols And Other Turks.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Military organization under the Mamluks and Khaljis
